policy: No sensitive item is withheld solely because it lacks complete source metadata, confirmation, or human review. Every item remains publishable only with an explicit evidence-status label that states whether it is source-linked, unconfirmed, source-incomplete, a model output, or not human reviewed. A label is not proof or a verdict.

labels.noAttributableSource: UNCONFIRMED · NO ATTRIBUTABLE SOURCE RULE · NOT HUMAN REVIEWED
labels.sourceIncomplete: SOURCE METADATA INCOMPLETE · NOT CONFIRMED · NOT HUMAN REVIEWED
labels.sourcedNotReviewed: SOURCED · NOT CONFIRMED · NOT HUMAN REVIEWED
labels.modelOutput: MODEL OUTPUT · NOT A CONFIRMED EVENT · NOT HUMAN REVIEWED
labels.staticContext: STATIC SOURCE CONTEXT · NOT HUMAN REVIEWED

boundaries: Publication does not convert an allegation, estimate, model score, association, or unsupported claim into fact.
Unreviewed items may not be described as human-confirmed evidence.
Automated refresh or promotion remains limited to complete source rules even though publication itself is allowed.
Corrections, counter-evidence, and later human-review decisions must remain visible and update the label rather than silently deleting history.
